get.description: Returns healthy when every dependency of the service answers.

503.description: The service is unavailable or not working correctly

error.message: The service is unavailable or not working correctly

post.description: Validates the config, stores a PENDING run and enqueues the job.

201.description: The test run was created and enqueued

503.description: Too many test runs are in progress, or the test job could not be enqueued

error.message: Too many test runs are in progress, or the test job could not be enqueued

get.description: Returns the run history, newest first, with cursor pagination. Configs and results are never included.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page

get.description: Returns the run status and final result. The config is never included.

post.description: Requests a stop and returns the current status. The status becomes STOPPED once the worker reports the run as finished.

get.description: Server-sent events. 'status' carries { status, reason? }: the current status right after connecting, then every change. 'snapshot' carries the per-second metrics of the run. The stream closes when the run reaches a final status.
get.summary: Stream live metrics of a test run

get.description: Returns the profile of the signed-in user.

post.description: Reads the refresh_token cookie, rotates it and sets new access_token and refresh_token cookies. A refresh token that was already used revokes the whole session. Every 401 clears both cookies. Public.

401.description: The session is invalid or has expired, sign in again

error.message: The session is invalid or has expired, sign in again

403.description: Requests from this origin are not allowed

error.message: Requests from this origin are not allowed

post.description: Revokes the session of the refresh_token cookie when it is valid and always clears both auth cookies. Idempotent. Public.

403.description: Requests from this origin are not allowed

error.message: Requests from this origin are not allowed

get.description: Returns the OAuth providers configured on the server. Public.
Sets the oauth_state cookie and redirects to the provider's consent page. On any error redirects to FRONTEND_URL/oauth/callback?error=<code> instead of returning JSON. Public.

302.description: Redirect to the provider, or to the frontend with an error code

get.description: Called by the provider. Checks the state, signs the user in or registers them, sets the access_token and refresh_token cookies and redirects to FRONTEND_URL/oauth/callback. On any error redirects to FRONTEND_URL/oauth/callback?error=<code> instead of returning JSON. Public.

302.description: Redirect to the frontend, with an error code on failure

reason.description: Failure reason, present on FAILED runs

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page, absent on the last page

reason.description: Failure reason, present on FAILED runs

result.description: Final result, absent on FAILED runs

avatarUrl.description: Avatar URL, absent when the user has none

id.description: Provider id, used in the OAuth URLs

name.description: Provider name to show on the sign-in button

OAuthProvidersResponseDto.description: OAuth providers configured on the server

retryable.description: Whether retrying the request may succeed
